verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and a hosted inference API/CLI (Wally), not a document-authoring product, so an agent-driven document workspace with autosave falls outside its category. The evidence shows no such workspace. The console playground only "keeps your recent conversations," which is chat history, not document drafting with automatic saving.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
